fact_grain: one successfully sold ticket, uniquely identified by ticket_id
success_condition: payment_attempt.status = 'SUCCEEDED' AND booking_order.paid_at IS NOT NULL
refunded_sales: keep original sale; do not filter ticket.status or require current order.status = 'PAID'

metrics.name: sold_ticket_count
metrics.label: 成功售票数
metrics.formula: COUNT(*) from unique ticket sale facts

metrics.name: paid_order_count
metrics.label: 成功支付订单数
metrics.formula: COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) in each paid_date/session_id group

metrics.name: paid_amount
metrics.label: 模拟支付金额
metrics.formula: SUM(booking_item.unit_price) from unique ticket sale facts

zero_amount_sales: count tickets and orders normally; amount contributes zero
empty_result: no aggregate rows; an overall total query returns counts 0 and decimal 0.00
freshness: committed records visible in the source snapshot; not a historical end-of-day snapshot
reprocessing: full snapshot and full history rebuild; same source batch and code version reproduce the same business result
